text:
nina: Quick follow-up from the postmortem for yesterday's streaming partials/timeouts. Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/184172 — using this thread to lock owners + minimal timelines.

oncall-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-184172 streaming-partial-timeout. Severity: P2.

lia: I can own reconnect logic and the reconnect storm mitigation. Plan: short-term gate reconnects to 3 attempts per connection + 250ms jittered linear backoff; long-term: queue-aware adaptive backoff. Canary ETA: today night.

mike: I'll take the SDK change to expose explicit reconnect reasons (timeout vs server-close) so we can correlate client-side behavior. Will have a patch and beta npm package by tomorrow.

alex: Observability gaps: missing streaming-error-cause tag and no aggregated partial_count metric. I'll add both and a heatmap for concurrent_conn spikes. ETA: 48h.

nina: Lia — include a graceful drain when we do hot model swaps to avoid KV key invalidation races. Short patch: mark swaps with a maintenance flag and delay evictions for 200ms.

lia: Good call. That will be in the same canary. Also adding a small token-based rate limiter per-connection to blunt bursts.

mike: SDK beta will surface codes and auto-backoff hints. We'll try to keep default behavior conservative to avoid client churn.

devex-bot: Reminder: push changelog entry required for SDK changes (template: https://redwood.internal/devex/changelog).

nina: Communication plan: I'll draft a short note for affected customers (dedicated + heavy-hosted users) explaining what happened, mitigations, and expected rollout dates. @alex please include dashboard links.

alex: Will add links to the new dashboard widgets. Preliminary query I'll use to join disconnects to model-version and client-version: ```sql
SELECT client_version, model_version, count(*) as disconnects
FROM streaming_events
WHERE event_type IN ('disconnect','partial') AND ts >= '2026-03-20'
GROUP BY client_version, model_version
ORDER BY disconnects DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

nina: Action tracker (concise):
- lia: reconnect/backoff + hot-swap drain + canary (owner: lia, ETA: today EOD)
- mike: SDK error codes + beta package (owner: mike, ETA: tomorrow)
- alex: streaming error metrics + heatmap (owner: alex, ETA: 48h)
- nina: customer note + postmortem addendum (owner: nina, ETA: tomorrow noon)

lia: I'm creating Jira tickets: RW-STR-451 (backoff), RW-STR-452 (hot-swap drain), RW-SDK-773 (sdk error codes).

mike: I'll mention the SDK beta in the release notes and ping the integrations slack channel when it's ready.

alex: Found pattern: partials spike ~150-300ms after connection surge. Adding synthetic test that ramps connections and verifies partial_count stays flat.

nina: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers post here. We'll review canary metrics in the weekly incident sync (Thu 09:00). I'll update the postmortem with this ownership table after canary results. :eyes:

oncall-bot: Weekly incident sync scheduled Thu 09:00 — agenda updated.
